$Comment: The Headless Horseman's fight, a Variant of this pack's Orbis_Boss_Encounter_Template (its
comment tells the whole flow). As players arrive (8 seconds on, once the intro camera is done),
four Jack Skeletons rise at the corners of the graveyard's fountain (GuardWave,
Macro_Orbis_Boss_Guards; its Parameters place them). Once all four are dead he rises from
Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Marker when players come near, in the saddle, with one health step
per player beyond the first. A wipe or a reset raises the four again.
Phase 1, the Ride: he dives low at a player, swings wide, laps the fountain, swoops through a
ringed spot and passes over the plaza dropping a ringed row of bombs (his mounted role and
Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride), and every 6 seconds a volley falls on rings marked under the
players (Macro_Orbis_Boss_Volley). Nothing is thrown at a player without a ring first. At half
his health he is thrown from the saddle: the game's own Gobliterator transition swaps him to
his foot role, invulnerable while it lands, and the music moves on; GuardTimeout is short, so
a bomb or swoop in flight delays the swap only a moment. Phase 2, the Head
(Macro_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head): on foot with two Jack Skeletons, his ringed slam and his
glowing dash; 6 seconds after his fall, and every 40 seconds after each flight ends, his head
flies off and his body, wrapped in a shield, cannot be hurt until players kill it. At 20%,
once his head has flown at least once (Macro_Orbis_Boss_Transition_HealthAndFlag on
Horseman_Head_Flown), phase 3, his Wrath (Macro_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Wrath): harder, faster,
two more Jack Skeletons, and burning volleys every 8 seconds. Solo, his 1100 health splits
550 in the saddle, 330 on foot and 220 in his Wrath. Through the whole fight a health pack
drops now and then on one of the points the graveyard's prefab tags Orbis_Boss_Health_Pack
(HealthPacks, the game's Feastmaster pickup, healing whoever walks into it), every 80 to 180
seconds (HealthPackInterval), half as often as the Feastmaster's 40 to 90. His death pays each
credited player the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily Claim and a roll on Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.
The fight's reach. The graveyard runs 110 blocks from the entrance room's back wall to its far
wall, and this script stands on the road south of the plaza, 61 and a half blocks from the
entrance room's door and about 50 from the far wall's corners. ArenaRange 61 (who is in the
fight, the wipe and empty-graveyard checks, the music) and ScalePlayerRange (the health steps)
count a player anywhere in the graveyard and nobody in the entrance room; only the outermost
graves by the north wall, past the road's fences, sit just outside it. CorpseRange 70 finds a
fallen player anywhere in the graveyard, and both kinds of volley reach every player in the fight
(the Range and VolleyRange forwarded below). LeashRange 57 holds him four blocks inside that: past
it the fight calls him back (Macro_Orbis_Boss_Hold) and he turns back toward the plaza, so he
never follows a player into the entrance room. No one sphere fits the graveyard exactly, so move
the script's cell in tools/arenas/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json and these numbers together.
Tune a phase's numbers in _ForwardedModifiers below (the transitions' HealthRange, the first
volley's Interval), the health packs in HealthPackInterval, or the phase macros' own
Parameters. The binding row
ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter.json names the fight and
keeps its records. This file's name is not a role's: a script named after a role replaces it.
